==Description==
'''Classic Party''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|300}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/1/profile Roblox]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

==Gallery==

{{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}}
<gallery>
ClassicParty.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020)
</gallery>
}}

==Trivia==
*The original animation for '''Classic Party''' [[Emotes|emote]] was taken from the {{RLinkC|27858062|Dance Potion}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
**The music that used to play when '''Classic Party''' was being performed was also taken from it.
*This was one of the first emotes to be added to the game.

==Update History==
*'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]]
**'''Classic Party''' added.
*'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]]
**Animation replaced.
**Music removed.
**Cost decreased from {{Coins|350}} to {{Coins|300}}.
